policy_analysis.purpose: Separate political instrument wording, actor attribution, legal modality, document status and implementation evidence.
review_questions: Which actor is speaking, and through which instrument?
Is this an adopted wording, a proposal or a separately observed implementation?
What current evidence or competing interpretation is missing?

mediation.purpose: Prepare consent, interests, constraints and ownership questions without presuming agreement.
review_questions: Whose consent and representation have actually been evidenced, on what date?
Which affected groups and competing interests need direct consultation?
Does guidance support a question rather than a conclusion about this process?

media_narrative.purpose: Keep publisher, byline, attributed speaker, selected wording and analyst framing separate.
review_questions: Is this the outlet's wording or a statement attributed to somebody else?
What matched outlets, time windows and omitted perspectives should be sampled?
What evidence supports any ownership or influence claim? No blanket bias score.

hr_policy.purpose: Identify evidence required for jurisdiction-specific policy review; no automated legal applicability.
review_questions: Has the instrument text been directly verified?
What ratification, domestic law, worker scope and organizational rules apply?
Who will review the policy and test accessible reporting/remedy provisions?

resolution_brief.output: Attributed instrument brief, explicit implementation gaps
review_questions: Do legal verbs survive paraphrase?
Are adoption and execution kept separate?

communique_comparison.output: Side-by-side statements with wording differences and evidence links
review_questions: Is the same clause compared?
Does a later endorsement alter wording or merely reference it?

mediation_preparation.output: Consent and representation questions for human preparation
review_questions: Which parties have not been consulted?
Can any claimed mandate or consent have changed?

media_framing_review.output: Annotated matched sample with rival frame interpretations
review_questions: Is the sample sufficient for a claim beyond this headline?
Are motives and ownership effects supported, rather than assumed?

hr_policy_application.output: Draft applicability checklist and policy questions
review_questions: Has a qualified reviewer checked local applicability?
Which accessibility, privacy and retaliation issues need organization-specific design?

limits: Four directly checked sources and one indexed candidate; selected excerpts, not a full political or media corpus.
Source verification by an automated research agent is distinct from human review; no human approval is asserted.
Default lens queries exclude candidates and analyst drafts. Source assertions may be normative or indirectly attributed; source_verified does not certify real-world truth.
Published-by filters source publication dates only, not a historical knowledge snapshot, legal validity or present applicability.
No live D1 connection, automatic legal conclusion, motive diagnosis, outlet-wide bias score, full conflict ontology or measured model-quality gain is implemented.
